```{r}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(here)

projects <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "new_projects.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
schools  <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "schools.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# Date range defaults: current school year (Aug 1 - Jul 31)
school_year_start <- if (as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%m")) >= 8) {
  paste0(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y"), "-08-01")
} else {
  paste0(as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")) - 1, "-08-01")
}
date_min <- school_year_start
date_max <- as.character(Sys.Date())

# Known EPI school names (canonical list)
known_schools <- schools$school_name

# Build a simplified project list for client-side rendering
proj_list <- projects |>
  mutate(
    project_date = as.character(project_date),
    is_new_school = !(school_name %in% known_schools),
    # Partnership info
    has_partner = case_when(
      `9` == "Yes" & !is.na(`9_2_TEXT`) & !`9_2_TEXT` %in% c("No", "NA", "") ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),
    partner_name = if_else(has_partner, `9_2_TEXT`, NA_character_),
    # Notes (Q67) - exclude "No" and empty
    notes = if_else(
      !is.na(`67`) & !`67` %in% c("No", "No.", "NA", "N/A", ""),
      `67`, NA_character_
    ),
    # Build project-type-specific summary
    summary = case_when(
      # MGR Installation
      str_detect(project_type, "MGR") ~ paste0(
        if_else(!is.na(`12_1`), paste0(`12_1`, " lanterns distributed"), ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`13`), paste0(", ", `13`, " lantern groups"), ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`14`), paste0(" (~", `14`, " students/group)"), ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`10`) & `10` == "Yes" & !is.na(`11`),
          paste0(". MGR moved from ", `11`), ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`17_1`), paste0(". ", `17_1`, " computers given"), "")
      ),
      # Solar
      str_detect(project_type, "Solar") ~ paste0(
        if_else(!is.na(`28`), paste0(`28`, " solar panels installed"), "Solar panels installed"),
        if_else(!is.na(`12_1`), paste0(", ", `12_1`, " lanterns"), "")
      ),
      # Starlink
      project_type == "Starlink" ~ paste0(
        "Starlink installed",
        if_else(!is.na(`21`) & `21` == "Yes", " in EPI computer lab", ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`22`) & str_detect(`22`, "removed"), ". RACHEL device replaced", "")
      ),
      # Building Construction
      str_detect(project_type, "Building") ~ paste0(
        if_else(!is.na(`29`), `29`, "Building"),
        if_else(!is.na(`30`), paste0(" (", `30`, " rooms)"), ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`33_1`) & `33_1` != "0", paste0(". ", `33_1`, " science kits given"), ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`36`) & `36` != "0", paste0(". Menstrual kits distributed"), "")
      ),
      # GROW Project
      project_type == "GROW Project" ~ paste0(
        "GROW Project",
        if_else(!is.na(`47`) & str_detect(`47`, "Yes"), " with library books from EPI", ""),
        if_else(!is.na(`50`) & !`50` %in% c("Nothing", "", "NA", "Other:"),
          paste0(". Also distributed: ", str_remove(`50`, ",?\\s*Other:?\\s*")), "")
      ),
      # Fallback
      TRUE ~ project_type
    )
  ) |>
  # Clean up leading/trailing commas and spaces in summary
  mutate(summary = str_remove(summary, "^,\\s*") |> str_remove(",\\s*$") |> str_squish()) |>
  select(project_date, project_type, school_name, is_new_school, visitor,
         has_partner, partner_name, summary, notes) |>
  arrange(desc(project_date))

proj_json <- toJSON(proj_list, auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null")
n_projects <- nrow(proj_list)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

htmltools::HTML(paste0(
'<!-- Filters -->
<div style="display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:0.75rem; align-items:center; margin-bottom:1.5rem; justify-content:center;">
  <label style="font-weight:600; color:var(--epi-navy);">Date Range:</label>
  <input type="date" id="date-start" value="', date_min, '" style="padding:0.35rem; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px;">
  <span>to</span>
  <input type="date" id="date-end" value="', date_max, '" style="padding:0.35rem; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px;">
  <select id="type-filter" style="padding:0.35rem 0.5rem; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:4px; max-width:220px;">
    <option value="">All Project Types</option>
  </select>
  <button id="btn-apply-dates" style="background:var(--epi-navy); color:#fff; border:none; padding:0.4rem 1rem; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600;">Apply</button>
  <button id="btn-reset-dates" style="background:#e9ecef; color:#333; border:none; padding:0.4rem 1rem; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer;">Reset</button>
</div>

<!-- Project Cards Container -->
<div id="projects-container"></div>

<script>
var ALL_PROJECTS = ', proj_json, ';

// Color mapping for project types
var TYPE_COLORS = {
  "Electricity Generating MGR Installation": {bg: "#fff3cd", border: "#ffc107", label: "MGR Installation"},
  "Solar Project for Lanterns Specifically (No MGR)": {bg: "#d1ecf1", border: "#17a2b8", label: "Solar (Lanterns)"},
  "Solar Project (not for lanterns)": {bg: "#d1ecf1", border: "#17a2b8", label: "Solar"},
  "Starlink": {bg: "#e2e3f1", border: "#6f42c1", label: "Starlink"},
  "Building Construction": {bg: "#f5d6cc", border: "#dc3545", label: "Building Construction"},
  "GROW Project": {bg: "#d4edda", border: "#28a745", label: "GROW Project"},
  "Science Kit Distribution": {bg: "#fde8d0", border: "#fd7e14", label: "Science Kits"},
  "Menstrual Kit Distribution": {bg: "#f8d7da", border: "#e83e8c", label: "Menstrual Kits"}
};

function getTypeInfo(projectType) {
  // Check for exact match first
  if (TYPE_COLORS[projectType]) return TYPE_COLORS[projectType];
  // Check for partial matches (for combined types like "Building,Science,Menstrual")
  for (var key in TYPE_COLORS) {
    if (projectType.indexOf(key) >= 0) return TYPE_COLORS[key];
  }
  return {bg: "#e9ecef", border: "#6c757d", label: projectType};
}

function makeProjectCard(p) {
  var typeInfo = getTypeInfo(p.project_type);
  var types = p.project_type.split(",");

  var badgesHtml = "";
  types.forEach(function(t) {
    var info = getTypeInfo(t.trim());
    badgesHtml += \'<span style="display:inline-block; background:\' + info.bg + \'; color:#333; border:1px solid \' + info.border + \'; padding:0.15rem 0.6rem; border-radius:12px; font-size:0.75rem; font-weight:600; margin-right:0.35rem; margin-bottom:0.25rem;">\' + info.label + \'</span>\';
  });

  var html = \'<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.25rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); margin-bottom:1rem; border-left:4px solid \' + typeInfo.border + \';">\';

  // Header row: school name + date
  html += \'<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; margin-bottom:0.5rem; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:0.5rem;">\';
  html += \'<div>\';
  html += \'<span style="color:var(--epi-navy); font-weight:700; font-size:1.05rem;">\' + p.school_name + \'</span>\';
  if (p.is_new_school) {
    html += \' <span style="background:#dc3545; color:#fff; padding:0.1rem 0.5rem; border-radius:10px; font-size:0.7rem; font-weight:600;">NEW SCHOOL</span>\';
  }
  html += \'</div>\';
  var dateStr = p.project_date || "";
  if (dateStr) {
    var d = new Date(dateStr + "T00:00:00");
    dateStr = d.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric"});
  }
  html += \'<span style="color:#999; font-size:0.8rem; white-space:nowrap;">\' + dateStr + \'</span>\';
  html += \'</div>\';

  // Type badges
  html += \'<div style="margin-bottom:0.5rem;">\' + badgesHtml + \'</div>\';

  // Partner
  if (p.has_partner && p.partner_name) {
    html += \'<p style="font-size:0.85rem; margin:0.25rem 0; color:#555;"><strong>Partner:</strong> \' + p.partner_name + \'</p>\';
  }

  // Summary
  if (p.summary && p.summary !== p.project_type) {
    html += \'<p style="font-size:0.9rem; margin:0.4rem 0 0; color:#333;">\' + p.summary + \'</p>\';
  }

  // Notes
  if (p.notes) {
    html += \'<p style="font-size:0.85rem; margin:0.4rem 0 0; color:#666; font-style:italic;">Notes: \' + p.notes + \'</p>\';
  }

  // Visitor
  if (p.visitor) {
    html += \'<p style="font-size:0.8rem; margin:0.35rem 0 0; color:#aaa;">Recorded by \' + p.visitor + \'</p>\';
  }

  html += \'</div>\';
  return html;
}

// Populate project type dropdown from data
function populateTypeFilter() {
  var select = document.getElementById("type-filter");
  var currentVal = select.value;
  var types = {};
  ALL_PROJECTS.forEach(function(p) {
    if (p.project_type) {
      // Split combined types (e.g. "Building Construction,Science Kit Distribution")
      p.project_type.split(",").forEach(function(t) {
        var trimmed = t.trim();
        var info = getTypeInfo(trimmed);
        types[trimmed] = info.label;
      });
    }
  });
  select.innerHTML = \'<option value="">All Project Types</option>\';
  Object.keys(types).sort().forEach(function(key) {
    var opt = document.createElement("option");
    opt.value = key;
    opt.textContent = types[key];
    select.appendChild(opt);
  });
  select.value = currentVal;
}

function renderProjects() {
  var startDate = document.getElementById("date-start").value;
  var endDate = document.getElementById("date-end").value;
  var typeFilter = document.getElementById("type-filter").value;

  var filtered = ALL_PROJECTS.filter(function(p) {
    if (!p.project_date) return true;
    if (startDate && p.project_date < startDate) return false;
    if (endDate && p.project_date > endDate) return false;
    if (typeFilter && (!p.project_type || p.project_type.indexOf(typeFilter) < 0)) return false;
    return true;
  });

  // Render cards
  var container = document.getElementById("projects-container");
  if (filtered.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = \'<div style="background:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:1.5rem; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#999; font-style:italic; margin:0;">No projects found in this date range.</p></div>\';
    return;
  }

  var html = "";
  filtered.forEach(function(p) {
    html += makeProjectCard(p);
  });
  container.innerHTML = html;
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  populateTypeFilter();
  renderProjects();
  document.getElementById("btn-apply-dates").addEventListener("click", renderProjects);
  document.getElementById("type-filter").addEventListener("change", renderProjects);
  document.getElementById("btn-reset-dates").addEventListener("click", function() {
    var now = new Date();
    var syYear = now.getMonth() >= 7 ? now.getFullYear() : now.getFullYear() - 1;
    document.getElementById("date-start").value = syYear + "-08-01";
    document.getElementById("date-end").value = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    document.getElementById("type-filter").value = "";
    renderProjects();
  });
});
</script>
'))
```
